then come apart into homing black threads

Hold the left button for three cuts: a downward chop, a level sweep and an overhand fling that throws a shadow of the sword

In hand, the left or right button is the Knight's Dream Nail: hold to charge, release to slash
Reads the thoughts of creatures and enters dreams; its damage grows with your progress; Awoken, it deals 50% more
Hold S as it slashes to set a Dreamgate, hold W to travel to it
In a Dreamer's dream, once the Dreamer is struck down, hold the left or right button to focus and drain it
Cannot be sold, thrown away or trashed
拿在手上时，左键或右键就是空洞骑士的梦之钉：按住蓄力，松开挥出\n能读出生物的想.zh-Hant:
拿在手上時，左鍵或右鍵就是空洞騎士的夢之釘：按住蓄力，放開揮出
能讀出生物的想法，進入夢境，傷害隨進度提升，覺醒後再提高 50%
按住 S 揮出放下夢之門，按住 W 揮出傳送到夢之門
在守夢人的夢裡打傷守夢人後，按住左鍵或右鍵就是聚集，吸收守夢人
不能出售、丟棄，也不能丟進垃圾桶
拿在手上时，左键或右键就是空洞骑士的梦之钉：按住蓄力，松开挥出\n能读出生物的想.ja-JP:
手に持つと、左クリックか右クリックが騎士の夢見の釘になる：長押しで溜め、離して振る
生き物の思考を読み、夢に入る。ダメージは進行度に応じて上がる。覚醒するとさらに 50% 上がる。
Sを押しながら振ると夢見の門を置き、Wを押しながら振るとそこへ移動する
夢見る者の夢の中で夢見る者を傷つけたら、左クリックか右クリックを長押しすると集中になり、夢見る者を吸収する
売却、投棄、ゴミ箱への廃棄はできない

손에 들면 왼쪽이나 오른쪽 버튼이 기사의 꿈의 못이 된다: 누르고 있으면 모으고, 떼면 휘두른다
생물의 생각을 읽고 꿈에 들어간다. 피해는 진행도에 따라 오른다. 각성하면 50% 더 오른다
S를 누른 채 휘두르면 꿈의 문을 놓고, W를 누른 채 휘두르면 그곳으로 이동한다
꿈꾸는 자의 꿈에서 꿈꾸는 자에게 상처를 입힌 뒤 왼쪽이나 오른쪽 버튼을 누르고 있으면 집중이 되어 꿈꾸는 자를 흡수한다
팔거나 버리거나 휴지통에 넣을 수 없다

S beim Schlag halten setzt ein Traumtor, W halten reist dorthin
Im Traum eines Träumers: ist der Träumer niedergestreckt, halte die linke oder rechte Taste, um dich zu konzentrieren und ihn aufzunehmen
Kann nicht verkauft, weggeworfen oder in den Müll gelegt werden
拿在手上时，左键或右键就是空洞骑士的梦之钉：按住蓄力，松开挥出\n能读出生物的想.fr-FR:
En main, le bouton gauche ou droit est l'Aiguillon onirique du Chevalier : maintenir pour charger, relâcher pour frapper
Lit les pensées des créatures et entre dans les rêves ; ses dégâts augmentent avec ta progression ; éveillé, il inflige 50 % de dégâts en plus
Maintiens S en frappant pour poser une Porte onirique, W pour t'y rendre
Dans le rêve d'un Rêveur, une fois le Rêveur abattu, maintiens le bouton gauche ou droit pour te concentrer et l'absorber
Ne peut être ni vendu, ni jeté, ni mis à la corbeille

Mantén S al golpear para colocar una Puerta onírica, W para viajar a ella
En el sueño de un Soñador, una vez herido el Soñador, mantén el botón izquierdo o derecho para concentrarte y absorberlo
No se puede vender, tirar ni mandar a la papelera

Tieni premuto S mentre colpisci per piazzare un Portale dei sogni, W per raggiungerlo

O dano aumenta com o estágio, e cada melhoria do ferreiro de ferrões adiciona 25%
Não pode ser vendido, largado nem jogado no lixo

戴着时：骨钉技艺蓄满后还能继续蓄力 1.5 秒，分三段，最多伤害 +60%、范围.en-US: While worn: a charged nail art can go on charging for 1.5 seconds more, in three steps, up to +60% damage, +35% size and double knockback

戴着时：近战伤害提高 10%，骨钉伤害提高 30%（碎了就没有效果）.en-US: While worn: melee damage +10%, the nail +30% (nothing once broken)

戴着时：骨钉技艺蓄力快 30%，骨钉挥砍的间隔缩短 30%.en-US: While worn: nail arts charge 30% faster, and the nail swings 30% sooner after each slash

戴着时：骨钉每次命中，紧接着再劈一刀，造成这一击 30% 的伤害，必定暴击.en-US: While worn: every nail hit is followed at once by a second cut for 30% of it, always a critical hit

戴着时：骨钉每次挥砍都朝挥砍方向射出一道白色剑气，造成一半伤害，能穿过敌人，碰墙.en-US: While worn: every nail slash throws a white crescent of light its way for half its damage, through enemies, gone at a wall

戴着时：暗影冲刺冲得更快更远，穿过的敌人受到骨钉 1.5 倍的伤害.en-US: While worn: the shadow dash goes faster and farther, and enemies it passes through take one and a half nail blows

戴着时：魔法伤害提高 15%，所有魔法弹幕变大 30%.en-US: While worn: magic damage +15%, every magic projectile 30% bigger

戴着时：吉欧掉落增加 20%；近战和远程命中时吸取伤害的 3% 回复生命（每秒最.en-US: While worn: 20% more geo; melee and ranged hits steal back 3% of their damage as life (at most 4 a second)

戴着时：吉欧掉落增加 30%。护符技（{0}）：在两种模式之间切换。鞭子模式：召.en-US: While worn: 30% more geo. Charm skill ({0}): switch between two modes. Whip mode: minion damage -40%, whip damage doubled; minion mode: minion damage +40%, but no weapon can be used. 3 s cooldown

戴着时：面具带来的青色心翻倍（碎了就没有效果）.en-US: While worn: the cyan hearts your masks give are doubled (nothing once broken)

戴着时：敌人掉落的吉欧增加 20%，多出来的会闪光（碎了就没有效果）.en-US: While worn: enemies drop 20% more geo, the extra glinting (nothing once broken)

戴着时：移动速度减半，所有职业的伤害提高 35%.en-US: While worn: movement speed halved, damage of every class +35%

戴着时：魔力消耗降低 10%，魔法武器的施法速度和间隔快 30%，弹药有 33%.en-US: While worn: mana cost -10%, magic weapons cast 30% faster, a 33% chance not to use ammo; ranged hits throw out a small seeking orb of magic

戴着时：魔法武器的魔力消耗减半；能打开通往出生地的门.en-US: While worn: magic weapons cost half the mana; opens the way to the Birthplace

戴着时：冲刺键的冲刺（克苏鲁之盾、黑冲白冲都算）冲向鼠标的方向；连按两下 W A.en-US: While worn: the Dash key's dash (the Shield of Cthulhu's, the Mothwing and Shade Cloaks' too) goes toward the cursor; double-tap W A S D to dash up, left, down or right (double-tapping down stays the armour's when it has an ability on it)

戴着时：原版的梦之盾绕着你转，而且是两面，在两侧各一面；挡下弹幕，碰到敌人造成骨.en-US: While worn: the game's Dreamshield circles you, two-sided, one shield on each side; it blocks shots and strikes enemies for 80% of a nail blow, breaking a while before it forms again

戴着时：召唤原版的编织者幼体攻击敌人；它们算作召唤物，吃召唤伤害加成和鞭子的标记.en-US: While worn: the game's Weaverlings fight for you; they count as minions, with your minion damage and whip tags on their bites

戴着时：格林之子（2 级起）攻击更强（随等级）、更频繁（每 0.9 秒一发）、更.en-US: While worn: the Grimmchild (from level 2) hits harder (by its level), more often (a shot every 0.9 seconds) and surer (no spread, faster fireballs that seek their target); it counts as a minion

戴着时：保留无忧旋律的守护之歌，有时挡下敌人的一次伤害；不会召唤格林之子.en-US: While worn: Carefree Melody sometimes blocks an enemy hit; it does not summon the Grimmchild
戴着时：保留无忧旋律的守护之歌，有时挡下敌人的一次伤害；不会召唤格林之子.zh-Hant: 戴著時：保留無憂旋律的守護之歌，有時擋下敵人的一次傷害；不會召喚格林之子

戴着时：穿着跑鞋在地面上奔跑直接就是最高速度，不用加速（没穿跑鞋没有效果）.en-US: While worn: with running boots on, running on the ground is at their top speed at once, no build-up (nothing without boots)

戴着时：梦之钉在空中也能蓄力，蓄力和挥出时都不会定住你，可以照常移动；蓄力更快，.en-US: While worn: the Dream Nail charges in the air too, and neither its charge nor its slash holds you still; it charges faster and draws out Essence more easily (the game's own)

这个形态下不能攻击.en-US: You can't attack in this form

噬魂者：召唤物模式下不能用武器攻击.en-US: Soul Eater: no weapon can be used in minion mode

遁入孢子毒雾：免疫所有伤害.en-US: In the spore cloud: immune to all damage

乌恩的光芒：W A S D 飞行.en-US: Unn's light: fly with W A S D

生命再生加快，受伤为止.en-US: Faster life regeneration until you are hurt

召唤物伤害提高 40%，不能用武器攻击.en-US: Minion damage +40%, no weapon can be used

一群热衷于搜罗闪光之物的小虫，会替持有者叼回散落的吉欧。\n唤醒它们时，虫群会荡.en-US:
A swarm of little bugs with a passion for shiny things. They fetch the Geo their bearer leaves lying about.
Called on, the swarm sweeps through the whole room the bearer stands in and brings back everything lying on the ground.

在交错的道路间低语着方向。\n它总是指向下一位等待持有者去挑战的强敌，并把通往那.en-US:
Whispers its direction among the tangled paths.
It always points to the next great foe awaiting its bearer, and quietly marks the way there on the map.

蕴含着获救幼虫们的感激之情。\n三只微光的小蝶绕着持有者飞舞，持有者受伤时，它们.en-US:
Contains the gratitude of freed grubs.
Three glowing moths circle the bearer; when the bearer is hurt, they sing and soothe the wounds.

由坚定不移的意志铸成。\n受伤后能多护住持有者片刻；张开时，外壳会吞下落在身上的.en-US:
Forged from an unwavering will.
It guards its bearer a moment longer after a hit. Raised, the shell swallows every blow that lands, then sends it all back at the enemy as a wave of light.

巴德尔坚硬的甲壳，熬过了无数漫长的岁月。\n持有者可以朝前方举起这面甲壳挡下攻击.en-US:
The hard shell of a Baldur, which has weathered countless long years.
The bearer can raise it ahead to block attacks; timed just right, even incoming projectiles are turned back the way they came.

体现了陨落勇士们的怒火。\n持有者濒临倒下时力量大增；也可以主动舍弃一部分生命，.en-US:
Embodies the fury of fallen warriors.
The bearer grows stronger as death draws near, and can give up some of their own life for a moment of doubled strength.

一枚蕴含着晶体的护符，能让持有者更快地平复下来。\n喝下药水后的不适消退得更快，.en-US:
A charm containing a crystal lens that helps its bearer settle more quickly.
The sickness after a potion fades sooner, and the body begins to heal sooner after a hit.

一颗不断渗出生命血的心脏。\n持有者可以随时唤起一层蓝色的生命血护盾，护盾在时，.en-US:
A heart that seeps precious lifeblood.
The bearer can call up a coat of blue lifeblood at will; while it holds, not even the heaviest blow reaches the body.

内含一颗活着的核心，源源不断地渗出珍贵的生命血。\n只要一段时间没有受伤，生命血.en-US:
Contains a living core that seeps precious lifeblood without end.
While the bearer stays unhurt for a while, the lifeblood gathers on them layer by layer as a shield.

圣巢之王赐给最忠诚的骑士的独特护符，满是刮痕和污渍，却一直被悉心照料。\n持有者.en-US:
Unique charm bestowed by the King of Hallownest on his most loyal knight. Scratched and dirty, but still cared for.
The bearer no longer fears spikes, thorns or acid; when enemies draw near, a heroic odour rises that poisons them.

住着一窝被遗弃的吸虫，它们把持有者当成了自己的母亲。\n有敌人进入身边的范围时，.en-US:
Home to a nest of abandoned flukes that take their bearer for their mother.
When enemies come within range, the flukes swarm out to bite them and carry the life they drink back to the bearer.

感知到持有者的痛苦，便以尖刺作为回应。\n每当持有者被敌人打中，带刺的藤蔓就会从.en-US:
Senses the pain of its bearer and lashes out with thorns.
Whenever an enemy strikes the bearer, thorned vines burst out and wound every enemy close by.

螳螂部族赠予值得尊敬的强者的印记。\n持有者的骨钉和手中的刀剑都能挥得更远。.en-US:
Given by the Mantis Tribe to those worthy of their respect.
The bearer's nail and blades reach further with every swing.

让持有者的身体稳如磐石，不再被自己的冲劲带着走。\n想走就走，想停就停，转身也毫.en-US:
Keeps its bearer's body steady as stone, never carried off by their own momentum.
They go, stop and turn the moment they wish. Awakened, it bathes them in gold, and every dash passes straight through enemies.

由陨落战士们的骨钉熔铸而成，让骨钉技艺更有分量。\n骨钉技艺蓄满之后还能继续积蓄.en-US:
Formed from the nails of fallen warriors, it gives the Nail Arts more weight.
Once a Nail Art is charged it can keep gathering strength, and is released heavier, larger and with greater force.

蕴含着一种被禁止的咒术，能把影子化为致命的武器。\n暗影冲刺冲得更快、更远，穿过.en-US:
Contains a forbidden spell that transforms shadows into deadly weapons.
Shadow dashes go faster and further, and cut through every enemy they pass.

由真菌荒地的蘑菇制成，至今仍在呼吸。\n持有者可以遁入一团孢子毒雾，雾中隐去身形.en-US:
Composed of living fungal matter. Still breathing.
The bearer can vanish into a cloud of spores, unseen and unharmed within it, while the spores slowly eat away at nearby enemies.

一枚造型修长的护符，让锋芒延伸得更远。\n骨钉和近战武器挥得更长，连隔着墙的敌人.en-US:
A long, slender charm that extends the reach of a blade.
The nail and melee weapons reach further, and can strike enemies even through walls.

据说蕴含着古代萨满的学识。\n持有者的魔法威力更强，放出的法术也更加庞大。.en-US:
Said to contain the knowledge of past generations of shaman.
The bearer's magic hits harder, and every spell it casts grows larger.

萨满们用来从活物身上收集灵魂的护符。\n持有者能从敌人身上收获更多吉欧，近战和远.en-US:
Used by shamans to draw more from the living things around them.
The bearer gathers more Geo from enemies, and draws back a wisp of life with each melee or ranged hit.

萨满们遗留的贪婪护符，会吞噬它触碰到的一切灵魂。\n持有者可以在两种战法之间切换.en-US:
A greedy relic left by the shamans that devours any soul it touches.
The bearer can switch between two ways of fighting: pour its strength into the whip, or give it all to their minions and strike no more themselves.

汲取持有者的魔力来孕育幼崽。\n战斗时会不断孵出小小的幼崽，扑向敌人炸开，威力随.en-US:
Drains the mana of its bearer to birth hatchlings.
In battle it keeps hatching little ones that hurl themselves at enemies and burst, as strong as the weapon in the bearer's hand.

让持有者的面具更加坚韧，面具带来的青色生命成倍增长。\n这枚护符很脆弱，持有者倒.en-US:
Strengthens the bearer's masks; the cyan life they give grows threefold.
This charm is fragile, and will break if its bearer is killed.

让持有者的面具更加坚韧，面具带来的青色生命成倍增长。\n这枚护符坚不可摧，再也不.en-US:
Strengthens the bearer's masks; the cyan life they give grows threefold.
This charm is unbreakable.

引导持有者心中的贪婪，敌人掉落的吉欧更多，多出来的还会闪闪发亮。\n这枚护符很脆.en-US:
Leads its bearer's greed: enemies drop more Geo, and the extra glitters.
This charm is fragile, and will break if its bearer is killed.

引导持有者心中的贪婪，敌人掉落的吉欧更多，多出来的还会闪闪发亮。\n这枚护符坚不.en-US:
Leads its bearer's greed: enemies drop more Geo, and the extra glitters.
This charm is unbreakable.

增强持有者的力量，近战武器和骨钉都打得更重，骨钉落下时火星四溅。\n这枚护符很脆.en-US:
Strengthens its bearer: melee weapons and the nail strike harder, and sparks fly where the nail lands.
This charm is fragile, and will break if its bearer is killed.

增强持有者的力量，近战武器和骨钉都打得更重，骨钉落下时火星四溅。\n这枚护符坚不.en-US:
Strengthens its bearer: melee weapons and the nail strike harder, and sparks fly where the nail lands.
This charm is unbreakable.

蕴含着骨钉大师们的热忱、骄傲与意志。\n持有者能更快地蓄好骨钉技艺，骨钉也挥得更.en-US:
Contains the passion, pride and will of the Nailmasters.
The bearer charges Nail Arts faster and swings the nail more often.

以“善良的异端”乔尼之名祝福的护符。\n持有者的脚步变得沉重缓慢，但每一次攻击都.en-US:
Blessed by Joni, the kindly heretic.
The bearer's steps grow heavy and slow, but every attack carries far greater force.

揭示了乌恩的形态。乌恩是苍绿之境的母亲，曾给子民带来宁静。\n骑乘坐骑时，弱小的.en-US:
Reveals the form of Unn, the mother of Greenpath, whose children knew peace.
While riding, lesser creatures leave the bearer be; and the bearer can become a glow of Unn's light, flying freely and still able to strike.

蜂巢的金色血液，承载着蜂群疗愈的力量。\n受伤后，下一瓶回血药水的效果会加倍；只.en-US:
Golden sap of the Hive, carrying the healing power of the swarm.
After a hit, the next healing potion works twice as well; and while the bearer stays unhurt for a while, honey slowly mends the body.

献给善用梦之钉的人，蕴含着梦境部族的智慧。\n梦之钉蓄力更快，在空中也能蓄力，挥.en-US:
Created for those who wield the Dream Nail, holding the wisdom of the dream tribe.
The Dream Nail charges faster, can be charged in mid-air and swung without stopping, and gathers Essence more readily.

冲刺之道的信徒留下的护符，他们一生都在追求更快、更远。\n冲刺会朝持有者瞄准的方.en-US:
Left by the devotees of the dash, who spent their lives chasing ever faster, ever further.
Dashes fly the way the bearer aims, and a double tap of a direction dashes up, down, left or right.

一位被遗忘的骨钉大师留下的护符，那位大师的刀快得让人看不清。\n骨钉挥出后毫不迟.en-US:
Left by a forgotten Nailmaster whose blade moved too fast to see.
The nail recovers at once after each swing, and every blow is followed by a silver second cut; the Nail Arts too.

体现了灵魂圣所法师们的意志。\n持有者施法更快、更省魔力，箭矢和弹药有时不会消耗.en-US:
Reflects the will of the mages of the Soul Sanctum.
The bearer casts faster and on less mana, sometimes keeps the ammunition they fire, and their ranged hits loose a small seeking orb.

在安静的洞穴深处天然形成，历经漫长的岁月慢慢长成。\n唤醒后持有者陷入专注，四周.en-US:
Naturally formed deep in a quiet cave over a long period of time.
Awakened, it sinks the bearer into focus: the world loses its colour, danger glows red, and the bearer and their own attacks glow blue. Awaken it again to come back.

承载着幼虫们蜕变后的感激，愿持有者也能获得新生。\n骨钉每次挥砍都会射出一道银色.en-US:
Contains the gratitude of grubs who have moved on to the next stage of their lives.
Every swing of the nail sends out a silver beam, and the Nail Arts loose bigger and more of them.

苍白之王护符的一块碎片。\n它本身没有力量，只有与另一半合在一起，才会显露真正的.en-US:
A fragment of the Pale King's charm.
It holds no power alone; only joined with its other half will its true radiance show.

圣巢之王留下的神圣护符，散发着苍白的光芒。\n持有者的魔法只需一半的魔力，它还能.en-US:
Holy charm left by the Pale King, glowing with a pale light.
The bearer's magic costs only half the mana, and it opens the way to the birthplace.

虚空的本源，再也不受任何意志的束缚。\n持有者的魔法只需一半的魔力，它也能打开通.en-US:
An emptiness that was hidden within, now unconstrained.
The bearer's magic costs only half the mana, and it opens the way to the birthplace. It has become one with the bearer and can never be removed.

带着一位奔跑狂热者的执念。\n穿着跑鞋奔跑时，一迈步就是最快的速度。.en-US:
Bears the obsession of one who lived to run.
In running boots, the bearer hits top speed from the very first step.

梦中凝成的盾，在持有者身边守望。\n如今它化成两面，绕着持有者旋转，挡下弹幕、撞.en-US:
A shield formed in a dream, keeping watch beside its bearer.
Now it has become two, circling the bearer to block projectiles and strike enemies, and lashing out with each swing of the nail.

编织者一族离开前留下的银色歌谣，能唤醒留在世间的编织者幼体。\n三只编织者幼体会.en-US:
Silken charm holding a song of farewell, left by the Weavers who departed.
It wakes three weaverlings who follow the bearer and pounce on nearby enemies.

格林剧团仪式的信物，一个渴望猩红火焰的孩子。\n它追随着持有者，长大后会朝附近的.en-US:
Symbol of a pact with the Grimm Troupe, a child hungry for scarlet flame.
It follows the bearer and, once grown, spits seeking fireballs at nearby enemies, stronger as the ritual nears completion.

纪念一段友谊开始的信物，里面藏着一首守护之歌。\n有时会替持有者挡下一次伤害。.en-US:
Token commemorating the start of a friendship.
Contains a song of protection that sometimes shields the bearer from harm.

看清危险：再按一次护符技关闭.en-US: Danger seen clearly: press the charm skill again to stop

背包里没有回城的物品（魔镜、冰雪镜、手机、回忆药水、返回药水）.en-US: No recall item in your inventory (Magic Mirror, Ice Mirror, Cell Phone, Recall Potion, Potion of Return)

背包里没有混沌传送杖.en-US: No Rod of Discord in your inventory

快捷键：可以在“泰拉瑞亚设置”的按键里绑定“{0}”，按下直接使用背包里的它.en-US: Hotkey: bind "{0}" in the Terraria Settings' keys to use it straight from your inventory

快捷键：按 {0} 直接使用（在背包里就行）.en-US: Hotkey: press {0} to use it (anywhere in your inventory)

戴着时：移动没有惯性，松开立刻停下，转身立刻转身，转身后的速度就是转身前的速度；.en-US: While worn: no momentum: stopped the moment you let go, turned at once, the turn keeping the speed you had; press a way again within 0.5 s of letting go and you set off at that speed. Charm skill ({0}): for 3 seconds you turn gold all over, and every dash is invincible and goes straight through enemies. 10 s cooldown

戴着时：面具带来的青色心变为 3 倍（碎了就没有效果）.en-US: While worn: the cyan hearts your masks give are tripled (nothing once broken)

戴着时：骨钉挥砍没有后摇；骨钉和骨钉技艺每次命中，紧接着再劈一刀银色的，造成这一.en-US: While worn: the nail's swing has no recovery; every hit of the nail and its arts is followed at once by a silver second cut for 30% of it, always a critical hit

戴着时：骨钉每次挥砍都朝挥砍方向射出一道银色剑气，造成一半伤害，能穿过敌人，碰墙.en-US: While worn: every nail slash throws a silver crescent of light its way for half its damage, through enemies, gone at a wall; the Great Slash and the Dash Slash throw a big one, the Cyclone Slash throws them to both sides as it spins

戴着时：骑在坐骑上，小怪和精英不会主动攻击你，除非你打了它们（首领照常）。护符技.en-US: While worn: riding a mount, common enemies and elites leave you alone unless you strike them (bosses as ever). Charm skill ({0}): become a ball of Unn's light for 5 seconds, flying up, left, down and right with W A S D; you can still be hurt, and can attack. 15 s cooldown

护符技（{0}）：开启或关闭专心模式。开启后一直生效，直到再按一次关闭：整个场景.en-US: Charm skill ({0}): switch focus mode on or off. On, it lasts until you press again: the whole scene turns grey, enemies and their attacks and shots glow red, and you and your shots, weapon attacks and minions glow blue. No cooldown

存档已满（最多 {0} 个世界）：先删除一个再新建。.en-US: All save slots are full ({0} worlds at most): delete one before making a new one.

右键：按住连续出拳.en-US: Right click: hold to punch again and again

右键：按住举起护盾防护（需要装备盾牌），刚举起时挡下攻击可以招架反击.en-US: Right click: hold to raise a shield (one must be worn); a blow met as it comes up is parried and answered

右键：按住蓄力，松开挥出一道白波飞向鼠标处，碰到敌人爆炸；蓄满时一次三道.en-US: Right click: hold to charge, let go to cut a soul wave at the cursor that bursts on the first enemy; fully charged, three at once

右键：按住蓄力，松开一记贯穿突刺，刺得更远（2～4 倍伤害）.en-US: Right click: hold to charge, let go for a piercing thrust that reaches further (2-4x damage)

右键：按住蓄力，松开朝上、中、下连刺三枪.en-US: Right click: hold to charge, let go to thrust three times, high, level and low

右键：按住蓄力，松开化作暗影朝面向突刺穿过敌人.en-US: Right click: hold to charge, let go to become a shadow and thrust through enemies the way you face

右键：按住蓄力，松开朝面向突刺穿过敌人.en-US: Right click: hold to charge, let go to thrust through enemies the way you face

右键：按住蓄力，松开朝鼠标方向掷出一排雷枪（蓄满五道）.en-US: Right click: hold to charge, let go to hurl a fan of lightning spears at the cursor (five when full)

右键：把长柄抡圆，在身边旋转扫击两圈半.en-US: Right click: whirl the polearm round you two and a half times, striking all about

右键：把永恒之枪朝鼠标方向投出，贯穿沿途的敌人.en-US: Right click: hurl Gungnir at the cursor, piercing the enemies in its way

右键：在鼠标处降下一排冰枪.en-US: Right click: rain a row of ice spears down on the cursor

右键：舞动枪花，向四周吹出孢子云.en-US: Right click: twirl the spear, blowing spore clouds out all around

右键：舞动枪花，向四周撒出一圈发光蘑菇.en-US: Right click: twirl the spear, scattering a ring of glowing mushrooms all around

右键：按住蓄力，松开朝面向疾风突斩，沿途放出切割疾风飞向鼠标处.en-US: Right click: hold to charge, let go to dash the way you face in a gale cut, loosing cutting gales at the cursor from along the way

右键：流星连刺，一阵加倍的星光突刺.en-US: Right click: a meteor flurry, a burst of starlit thrusts twice as big

掉落阶段 {0} · 只改变掉落，角色与敌人数值保持当前进度.en-US: Loot stage {0} · Character and enemy stats stay at current progress

掉落阶段 {0} · 由房主选择，角色与敌人数值保持当前进度.en-US: Loot stage {0} · Host controlled; character and enemy stats stay unchanged

背包里的物品堆到 {0} 个家园里已有同种物品的仓储.en-US: Puts the bag's items onto the storages of {0} homes that already hold them

重做的武器：近战连招和右键技艺，长枪、悠悠球、链枷、投掷武器、短剑和鞭子的新招式.en-US: The remade weapons: melee combos and right-click arts, new moves for spears, yoyos, flails, thrown weapons, shortswords and whips, the magic weapons' casts. Can't be changed once the world is made.

泰拉瑞亚原本的武器用法和动作。建好世界后不能更改。.en-US: Terraria's own weapon moves and animations. Can't be changed once the world is made.

创建世界时选定，之后不能更改；以前的存档用原版武器.en-US: Chosen when the world was made, for good; saves from before use Terraria's weapons

瞄准镜的右键视野；关掉不影响属性.en-US: The scopes' right-button view; off, their stats still count

背包里快捷栏以下的物品（收藏的除外）全部存进这片区域.en-US: Everything in the bag below the hotbar (favourites aside) goes into this area's storage

背包里快捷栏以下的物品（收藏的除外）堆进所有家园里已有同种物品的储物空间.en-US: The bag's items below the hotbar (favourites aside) are stacked onto any home's storage already holding them

更换这片区域的光环颜色，或给它改名.en-US: Change this area's aura colour, or rename it

灰色的颜色已被其他家园占用.en-US: Greyed colours are taken by other homes

放置后连接上下左右10格内的储物空间与制作站\n右键放置物或在背包里点家园按钮，.en-US:
Once placed, links the storage and crafting stations within 10 tiles each way
Right-click it, or press the home button in the bag, to use this area's items from afar and craft with its materials and stations
In the storage, "Colour / name" changes its aura colour (64, never shared between homes) and its name; areas don't share materials or stations

左键打开区域，右键更改颜色和名称.en-US: Left click opens the area, right click changes its colour and name

选择上方色块打开区域仓库\n同一区域的所有储物空间合并显示.en-US:
Pick a colour above to open an area's storage
All of an area's storage shows as one

统一堆叠并排序所有箱子，不受搜索筛选影响.en-US: Stacks and sorts every chest together, whatever the search shows

区域仓库 · 左键存取，右键取一个，Shift移入背包.en-US: Area storage · Left click takes or puts, right click takes one, Shift moves into the bag

点击更换光环颜色.en-US: Click to change the aura colour

空中连按两下下键：黑砸，猛击伤害为普通下砸的两倍\n落地短暂无敌，并砸开脆弱地板.en-US:
Double-tap Down in the air: Descending Dark, its slam hitting twice as hard as a plain dive
Briefly invincible on landing, and it breaks fragile floors; 2 s cooldown

放入武器，在原版与新版之间改制.en-US: Put in a weapon to refit it between its Terraria and its remade version

保留词缀和锻造；价格按武器阶段与稀有度计算.en-US: Prefix and forging are kept; the price goes by the weapon's stage and rarity

这件物品没有另一版本.en-US: This item has no other version

敲击改制 · 必定成功，武器数量不变.en-US: Strike to refit · always succeeds, the weapon count stays the same

无法改制：请检查武器或吉欧是否足够.en-US: Can't refit: check the weapon and that you have enough Geo

找回已获得的装备，不补售钥匙、矿石、遗物等消耗品.en-US: Buy back gear you have found; keys, ore, relics and other consumables aren't restocked

名单中的掉落物拾取时自动出售.en-US: Listed drops are sold as you pick them up

点击背包物品出售，可在出售栏按原价买回.en-US: Click an item in the bag to sell it; buy it back at the same price from the sold row

掉落物黑名单 · 拾取时自动出售.en-US: Drop blacklist · sold as you pick them up

名单只记录类型，不消耗添加的物品；之后捡到时自动出售.en-US: The list keeps only the kind of item, and the item added isn't used up; picked up later, it's sold

可冲刺撞击敌人\n双击方向键可冲刺.en-US:
Allows the player to dash into the enemy
Double tap a direction to dash

\"抓过来！\"\n按 E 朝光标抛出.en-US:
'Get over here!'
Press E to throw it at the cursor

造成会摧毁大部分图格的小爆炸\n能炸开需要下砸的地板.en-US:
A small explosion that will destroy most tiles
Breaks floors that need a dive

造成会摧毁大部分图格的大爆炸\n能炸开需要下砸的地板.en-US:
A large explosion that will destroy most tiles
Breaks floors that need a dive

可供攀爬\n按住上下攀爬.en-US:
Can be climbed on
Hold Up or Down to climb

存储物品的私人仓库\n放进去的增益站（水晶球、施法桌、利器站、弹药箱、战争桌、蛋.en-US:
Stores your items
Buff stations put in it (Crystal Ball, Bewitching Table, Sharpening Station, Ammo Box, War Table, Slice of Cake) and buff furniture (Campfire, Heart Lantern, Star in a Bottle, Bast Statue, Sunflower, Garden Gnome) still give their buffs

无需弹药或溶液\n喷射所经之处的泰拉瑞亚物块、背景墙和家具变为掉落物\n恢复被挖.en-US:
Needs no ammo or solution
The Terraria blocks, walls and furniture it sprays over drop as items
Restores the original ground changed by digging or meteorites
Containers and the tiles holding them up are left alone

在祭坛上按交互键（默认右键），吸收深渊尖啸.en-US: Press Interact (right click by default) at the altar to take in the Abyss Shriek

放大或缩小 mod 的全部界面：背包、生命和魔力、地图、聊天、提示和这个设置面板.en-US: Scales all of the mod's interface up or down: the bag, life and mana, the map, chat, tips and this settings panel. Like Terraria's UI Scale, from 50% to 200%, applied when you let go of the mouse; when the screen can't fit it, it shows at the most the screen can hold.

目标是布蕾塔家地下室的左特雕像，用梦之钉攻击雕像入梦。若入口未开放，请确认已两次.en-US: The target is Zote's statue in Bretta's basement: strike it with the Dream Nail to enter the dream. If the way isn't open, make sure you have saved Zote twice, rescued Bretta and beaten Zote in the Trial of the Warrior.

沿金色路线前进，光点标出房间出口；路线按房间连接，不代表可以穿过墙壁。.en-US: Follow the golden route; the dots mark the rooms' exits. The route links rooms and doesn't mean you can pass through walls.

暂未找到连通路线，请先探索连接区域。.en-US: No connected route found yet: explore the connecting areas first.

目标位于另一地图层；从路线标出的门进入，或切换浅层/深层查看后续路线。.en-US: The target is on another map layer: go in by the door the route marks, or switch between the shallow and deep layers to see the rest of the route.

在旁边的长椅上坐一下，就能点亮这座晶塔.en-US: Sit on the bench beside it to light this pylon

放在有空地的地面上（宽 3 格、高 4 格），之后和其他晶塔一样可以传送过来\n.en-US:
Place it on open ground (3 wide, 4 high); then you can teleport to it like any other pylon
Knock it down with a pickaxe to move it elsewhere

这座晶塔还没点亮，在旁边的长椅上坐一下.en-US: This pylon isn't lit yet: sit on the bench beside it

这个房间没有能传送进来的入口，不能放晶塔.en-US: This room has no way in to teleport to, so no pylon can go here

拿着我的合成表滚吧，把我丢弃在圣巢的烂人.en-US: Take my recipe book and get lost, you wretch who left me behind in Hallownest

合成表：放入一件材料，列出所有用到它的配方.en-US: Recipe book: put in a material to list every recipe that uses it

空洞骑士：原版地图；泰拉瑞亚：按实际地形一格一格画。两种都标出晶塔、居民、幼虫和.en-US: Hollow Knight: the game's own map; Terraria: drawn tile by tile from the real terrain. Both mark pylons, townsfolk, grubs and benches

衣柜穿戴副本：无价值，丢弃即消失.en-US: Wardrobe copy: no value, vanishes when dropped

获得这件时装后即可永久取用.en-US: Obtain this vanity piece once to take it out any time

请先放下鼠标上的物品.en-US: Put down the item on the cursor first

左键取用 · 右键穿戴 · 永久保留 · 副本无售价，丢弃即消失.en-US: Left click: take · Right click: wear · Kept for good · Copies have no value and vanish when dropped
